name: SLS Dubai Hotel & Residences

address.street: Marasi Dr - Business Bay - Dubai - United Arab Emirates

insider_take: This ultra-modern skyscraper hotel in Business Bay brings Philippe Starck's iconic design magic to Dubai's glittering skyline, where every floor offers breathtaking views of the Burj Khalifa and Dubai Canal.
whats_special: The hotel features the world's first SLS rooftop infinity pool on the 75th floor, making it one of the highest pools globally. The building's unique curved facade was inspired by traditional Arabic calligraphy, while celebrity chef José Andrés operates multiple restaurants within the property, including his acclaimed Bazaar Meat concept.
pro_tip: Book a table at Cleo for sunset dinner – the floor-to-ceiling windows provide unobstructed views of the Burj Khalifa's nightly light show, and you can watch the Dubai Fountain performance from 75 floors up.
dont_miss: The hotel's direct connection to Dubai Canal Walk, perfect for morning jogs with skyline views. Also experience the unique "SLS Elevator Art" – each elevator features rotating digital art installations by local Emirati artists, making every ride a mini gallery experience.
pros: Modern luxury design with contemporary lifestyle amenities
Prime Downtown Dubai location with iconic city skyline views
Innovative dining concepts and vibrant nightlife venues
Spacious residences with hotel services and facilities
cons: Urban setting may lack traditional resort tranquility
